justifications.type_expressiveness: Uses a newtype JobId, enum JobState, and typed QueueError variants, though Job's retry_at as Option<Instant> conflated with state could be folded into the JobState enum for tighter modeling.
justifications.error_handling: Typed error enum with distinguishing variants (UnknownJob, NotRunning) and Display impl; uses assert! in new() for the precondition rather than returning a Result, but otherwise avoids panics.
justifications.api_ergonomics: Sensible derives on JobState/JobId and Display on QueueError, but no doc comments on any public items and CheckedOut clones the payload unnecessarily.
justifications.idiomaticity: Uses iterators, ?, derives, and map_or appropriately, though the manual 1u32 << exponent overflow guard and payload.clone() in checkout are slightly clunky and matches! could replace the state comparisons.
